classification.difficultyReason: Form full-turn equations with several coefficients of one unknown and marked right angles.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of the pronumeral.

spec.description: Five separate rays with f, 82°, 95°, f and a lower-left right-angle square. No arcs or dots.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}f+82+95+f+90&=360\\2f+267&=360\\2f&=93\\f&=46.5\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Four rays: upper-right, shallow lower-right, down and shallow lower-left. Broad upper sector 138°; other three sectors a. No marks or dots.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}138+a+a+a&=360\\3a+138&=360\\3a&=222\\a&=74\end{align*}$$

spec.description: X-shaped diagonals and extra rightward ray; five sectors k, 33°, 54°, k, 87°. No arcs or dots.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}k+33+54+k+87&=360\\2k+174&=360\\2k&=186\\k&=93\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Six separate rays; 24° above the rightward ray, four successive e sectors, and lower-right right-angle square.
spec.mathematics: 4e+24+90=360. Approximate source alignments do not establish extra straight lines.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and four e labels only.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}e+e+e+e+24+90&=360\\4e+114&=360\\4e&=246\\e&=61.5\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three rays to near-up, upper-left and lower-left; a° in upper sector, square between left rays, and right-hand reflex arc labelled (4a)°.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+90+4a&=360\\5a+90&=360\\5a&=270\\a&=54\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Five rays with clockwise labels a°, a°, (3a)°, (4a)°, (3a)°. No arcs, squares or dots.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}a+a+3a+4a+3a&=360\\12a&=360\\a&=30\end{align*}$$
